page.layout: One page of running text, set in one column. Below the text, a block of Arabic verse set as one stanza, four lines. No marginal notes. Bottom right: catchword "In-". Bottom left: signature "Qq 3".

main_text.l: non esse verum, ac legitimum Concilij Ni-
cæni. De hoc enim nobis cum Hottingero,
& Symmystis inpræsens controuersia non
est: Sed utrum Romani Pontificis Monar-
chiam in suis Symbolicis scriptis asserant O-
rientales illæ Nationes, an vero cum Re-
formatis in hoc conueniant? Nobis enim sa-
tis est inpræsens ostendere, Canonem hunc
pro vero, ac legitimo Nicæno haberi a Chal-
dæis, Syris, & Arabibus, nempe Melchitis,
Maronitis, Iacobitis, Nestorianis & Cop-
titis, quibus adde Æthiopes, in quorum
omnium Conciliorum editionibus hic extat
Canon, & pro Nicæno habetur; refertur
que præterea in suarum Ecclesiarum Con-
stitutionibus cap. De Patriarchis. De hoc
vide quæ diximus par. 2. cap. 14. & seqq.
nostri Eutychij vindicati. Garrit igitur
Hottingerus hic, vt & alibi, atque gannit,
suaque conficitur rabie, nulla veritatis ha-
bita ratione; nihil tamen in Christum Do-
mini proficiens. Quamobrem audiat illud
Arabis Poëtæ, in ipsum pene compositum.
اصبر على حين الحسود فـ[?]اني صبرك قاتله فالنار تأكل بعضها ان لم تجد ما تأكله

page.notes: The Arabic verse is printed as four lines in Arabic script; I have transcribed it as one stanza. "فاني" is uncertain (marked). The Arabic letters are small and the scan is slightly blurred, so the vowelling and final letters of the fourth line are not fully certain. Running head: none printed. Page number 613 is printed at the top right. Left edge shows scan border and show-through, omitted.
